column1: # THE SFZ INSTRUMENT LIBRARY MANIFEST. Sampled instruments the studio's
# TillandsiasSFZRender node plays. They are NEVER baked into an image or a
# release: each is fetched on the user's own machine, on first request, into
# which extra_model_paths.yaml maps as the `sfz` folder (read-only at /models).
# The fetcher (a later slice, tasks 3.x) clones the repository at the pinned
# commit through the enclave proxy, verifies HEAD equals `commit` (the git
# commit is the content hash: it covers every sample), checks the LICENSE
# blob equals `licence_blob`, and drops .git. A row whose licence is not
# CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 is refused; CC-BY rows must carry `attribution`, which
# the render report and the export manifest copy (operator ruling 2026-11-13:
# Read from the GitHub API 2026-11-13 on macuahuitl: default-branch HEAD,
# /license (spdx_id and the LICENSE blob sha), and the repository size.
#   licence_path  the licence file in the repository at that commit
#   licence_blob  git blob sha of that file at that commit
#   size_kb       repository size the API reported (download estimate)
#   role          drums | bass | guitar | orchestral (a hint for agents)
#   attribution   required credit line for CC-BY rows, `-` for CC0
